title.narrative: The Church, Laudato Si’ and African Youth of Faith in Action

description.narrative:
The initiative aims to strengthen the role of youth and Catholic institutions in promoting environmental stewardship and climate advocacy across Africa, inspired by the principles of Laudato Si’. Building on previous successes, the project will raise awareness through capacity strengthening, Laudato Si’ Youth Assemblies, and advocacy, while also expanding the Science for Environmental Diplomacy initiative to engage more school-going boys and girls in environmental science and global policy processes.
Key activities include establishing environmental diplomacy clubs in schools, supporting youth participation in international climate policy platforms, and introducing practical, sustainable initiatives such as mini-tropical forests and chicken-rearing enterprises in Catholic-sponsored schools. These activities aim to build environmental leadership among young people, strengthen church-based climate advocacy, and create sustainable livelihood and learning opportunities within schools and communities.
